candidate.answerReason: The successive outer squares add 4,8,12,...,76 diamonds. Including the central diamond gives 1+19(4+76)/2=761.

methods.label: Count the added square layers
methods.explanation:
Count the diamonds on each newly added square separately. In \(F_2\), each side has two diamonds, its two corners. Each later square has one more diamond per side, so the outside square of \(F_k\) has \(k\) diamonds on each side for every integer \(k\ge 2\).

Counting its four sides gives \(4k\), but this counts each of the four corner diamonds twice. Subtracting one extra count for each corner, the new square contributes
\[
4k-4=4(k-1)
\]
diamonds. Every diamond belongs either to the original center or to exactly one added square, so adding these layer counts omits none and counts none twice.

From \(F_2\) through \(F_{20}\), there are \(19\) added squares, contributing
\[
4+8+12+\cdots+76.
\]
To sum them, write the terms in reverse order beneath the original order. Each corresponding pair sums to \(80\), so twice the sum is \(19\cdot80\). Including the central diamond, the total is
\[
1+\frac{19(4+76)}{2}
=1+760
=761.
\]
Thus \(F_{20}\) has \(761\) diamonds, choice \(\boxed{\text{E}}\).
